protocol_json_rebinding.detail: results/protocol.json embeds a sha256 of build/manifest.json (build_manifest_sha256) and of host-check.txt/host-check.json (host_check_sha256); results/matrix-complete.json embeds a sha256 of results/protocol.json. Sanitizing build/manifest.json and both host-check files changed their bytes, so these three hash fields were recomputed and updated in place; every other field (experiment constants, schedule seed, bound_file_sha256 for the unmodified kit scripts) is unchanged.
